{{Top|leg}}
'''DarkStryder technology''', also known as '''DarkStryder artifacts''' were unique technological creations built by [[DarkStryder]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The devices were powered by energy siphoned off from the [[Kathol (species)|Precursors]] trapped in the [[Lifewell]], and expended after use. The use of DarkStryder technology essentially killed the Precursors. The technology only worked reliably in proximity to Kathol. The further away from the planet the technology was, the less reliable it was.

==Known modules==
There were three common modules of DarkStryder technology, but it was theorized that many more, with other properties, existed.

*[[Firespray module]]
*[[Lightning module]]
*[[Mindwarper module]]
